params.caption: 🚨 Overwatch's ex-director Jeff Kaplan says he was in "constant fighting" with Blizzard for years before quitting. Exec interference and paywalled heroes were among his reasons. via @VGC_News @Blizzard_Ent #Overwatch #Blizzard #GamingNews
